name: foodjet
description: Food delivery platform - React frontend, NestJS API, PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @foodjet/api" "npm run dev -w @foodjet/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @foodjet/shared && npm run build -w @foodjet/api && npm run build -w @foodjet/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @foodjet/api && npm run lint -w @foodjet/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @foodjet/api && npm run test -w @foodjet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @foodjet/shared && npm run typecheck -w @foodjet/api && npm run typecheck -w @foodjet/web
